subject.title: fix(line): record every LINE push message id in send receipts

question: Should the LINE receipt contract intentionally replace the historical synthetic `"push"` and `"reply"` identifiers with real ordered LINE API identifiers and multi-part receipts for existing integrations?
rationale: The patch is a focused fix, but this observable receipt-output change can affect consumers that stored or compared the prior placeholders; only an owner can confirm the intended upgrade contract.

options.title: Confirm real IDs as the contract
options.body: Accept real ordered LINE identifiers and per-message parts as the corrected receipt behavior, then merge after normal checks complete.

options.title: Pause for a compatibility design
options.body: Keep the PR open if existing integrations require an explicit migration or compatibility plan before changing receipt values and cardinality.

recommendation.title: Confirm real IDs as the contract
recommendation.body: Accept real ordered LINE identifiers and per-message parts as the corrected receipt behavior, then merge after normal checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the concrete earlier review requirements for this receipt surface.
